transcript: In The Maenads, a new play at The Tank, five men climb a mountain to find themselves and to escape the chains of masculinity. Part of this involves role-playing as female followers of Dionysus, but things go off the rails pretty quickly. A drug trip, a lack of physical direction, and an ominous nightfall eventually break these guys down, making them more emotionally vulnerable than anyone would have expected. I like the concept here and I enjoyed a lot of the comedic moments, but parts of it felt half-baked. For example, I think it could’ve used a bit more clarity on the who, what, and why for each character to better orient us toward what the overall objective was going to be. I found it hard to get initially invested without a more comprehensive setup. Once we got into the meat of things though, it was a pretty entertaining watch, also helped by some design elements like the lighting and projections that I thought were really impressive for a small-scale production. The Maenads is running through October 12th at The Tank. With that, another program for my collection.
